Severity disagreement: MAJOR (gemini, minimax) vs NIT (sonnet, which does not count it as a gap because this is a no-behaviour-change refactor). Highest is MAJOR.

The failing tests do not read the checkout step body or any touched file. `tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py` was not checked.
